verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the task half of the story. Docs describe in-incident actions "that need doing now", separate from post-incident follow-ups, and say incident actions can be exported and synced to Asana. Nothing in the pack shows defined incident roles such as commander or comms lead, or structured checklist templates. Missing for 10: documented incident role assignment (commander, comms lead), role-specific responsibilities, checklist or task templates attached to incidents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
